provenance.method: points: shapely representative_point() of each (multi)polygon in EPSG:3083, transformed to EPSG:4326 and rounded to 6 decimals; districts: per plan, the district with the largest intersection area with the precinct in EPSG:3083 (ties to the lower number), share rounded to 4 decimals, split when share < 0.99, null when nothing overlaps
